# Superior Hunter's Defense (`features:hunter-superior-hunters-defense`)
**Class:** [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md) | **Subclass:** [Hunter](../subclasses/hunter.md) | **Level:** [Ranger 15](../levels/ranger-15.md)

When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.
